rationale: Frozen operation dataclass shape and required-field check; serialization/evidence shape with no tunable value.
Admission DoS bounds (1 MiB, depth 32, 10000 nodes); only rejects, never grants. Narrow-only below compiled ceiling is monotone; low value, must keep ceiling and fail closed on corrupt input.
Closed match-mode vocabulary; legacy-prefix is widening and must stay opt-in. Mode selection is already a host-supplied LocalExecutionPolicy field (segment->exact is narrowing) not a registry value.
Target-allow evaluator including well-formedness refusal (Cc/Cf, dot-segments); enforcement algorithm.
Re-validation that host-supplied max_amount/max_effects are strict finite/positive; fail-closed integrity check. Limit values themselves are host/grant-owned.
Authority-domain membership check against the local policy set; enforcement of authority boundary.
Deterministic ordering of failure evidence rows (created_at, failure_id); evidence-integrity read.
SQLite WAL journal mode for the attempt store durability; storage mechanism, not policy.
Append-only attempt event writer; evidence ledger mechanism. Status vocabulary is not validated here but no tunable value exists.
AttemptJoin field validity and no-self-merge checks; class_max_age value comes from resolver/profile, this is shape validation.
Refund intent scope match and commitment composition; binds action IDs and payload digest, evidence/authority binding.
Scrubbed env, pinned CLI digest, --no-login-shell, 64 KiB request cap and pinned gateway version; sandbox isolation invariants. Timeout already comes from config.
Destructive store mutator referenced only from tests in both old and current trees; not a production policy rule.
Fail-closed default recovery projection (retry_eligible False, authority none, unestablished); mandatory safe default.
Ordered block/escalate rule evaluator; blocked_tools list is already frame/PolicyConfig data, the precedence is the enforcement algorithm.
Canonical decision fingerprint (sort_keys, sha256); evidence-integrity serialization.
Mints one AuthorityRecord per entry with uuid, caller-given actor/source and no default expiry; authority creation must never be registry-governed.
Deterministic operand-shape derivation and fixed window semantics (start-exclusive/end-inclusive) of a measurement; period_seconds is already a caller argument. Observation, not policy.

Floor sets of action types needing block default/authority/review. action_type is an open str, so additive stricter membership for custom types is monotone, but ownership of risk classification is unclear; built-ins are a floor.
blocking_decision: Should deployers/tenants be allowed to add custom action types to _EFFECTFUL/_PRIVILEGED/_HIGH_RISK (additive only, built-in floor fixed), and who authorises that classification?

rationale: Exact-identifier/uniqueness manifest validation rules (E024/E025/E019); input integrity.
Undeclared-tool and non-block default on disallowed tool refusals (E006/E015); mandatory manifest consistency.
Single supported evidence classifier (MISSING/CONFLICT/UNKNOWN/STALE/VALID); max_age_seconds is supplied per obligation inside the signed profile, not hardcoded.
Closed reason-code syntax regex for rejections; vocabulary/serialization constraint.
Check-id charset/length guards lease file path (path confinement) plus flock liveness; mutual exclusion mechanism.
Age-bound algorithm; base bound is issuer-signed per-class max_status_age_seconds, extension cap from profile; irreversible classes never extended. Algorithm and floor stay.
Prior-attempt filter: an unresolved prior attempt blocks retry on observed absence; no count/age tunable, safety invariant against double effect.

_fresh evaluator stays; its thresholds are host constructor defaults (status/identity/mandate/approval max age 60s, clock tolerance 5s). Lowering only narrows, ceiling = compiled defaults; consumer exists.
blocking_decision: Whether verifier-side ceilings (vs issuer-signed per-class max_status_age) are meant to be operator-tunable; clock tolerance narrowing must not break skew-correct hosts.

rationale: Grant requirement/identity binding and validity-window enforcement; grant bounds come from issuer, the check is the evaluator.
Scope and limit enforcement against grant/permission; evaluator of issuer-owned values.
Approval binding/independence evaluator; its freshness uses approval_max_age_seconds, same candidate parameter family as W7-025, not a separate rule.
Runtime-authority extension validation; authority-bearing structural checks.
Effect limit comparison of proposal against manifest/permission limits; enforcement of issuer-declared bounds.
Required-scope subset check; authorization enforcement.
Proposal not_before/expires_at enforcement; times are caller-supplied request values, check is evaluator.
Permission matching and malformed-limit refusal (finite number, exact int, duplicate action name grants nothing); fail-closed evaluator.
Reversibility member validation and nested serialization of x_reversibility; wire format.
Pydantic evidence/record models for age extension, refusal and recovery report (extra=forbid, retained refusals); serialization shape. Located by symbol (freshness.py:83-108).
Defects that disqualify an age extension (unsigned, expired, cap exceeded); extension cap itself is profile-signed max_age_extension_seconds.
Effective-irreversibility evaluator (protected_read, counterparty_unobservable, window_passed -> irreversible); safety classification algorithm.
Closed Literal status/state vocabularies and tenant_id length bound on projection wire models; protocol constants.
1 MiB local input-file cap with hard-link and TOCTOU checks in an offline CLI; no registry consumer there, resource guard. Contrast W1-008 which sits in the runtime enforcement path.
Tenant presence requirement before AGT evaluation; fail-closed binding of tenant identity.
Pure escalation evaluator and reason codes; TTL/horizon/deadline values already come from trusted-host DedupeProfile (destination-declared, provider-owned) with ordering invariant.
0700/0600 modes, atomic temp+fsync+rename, exclusive create, path confinement; storage-integrity invariants.
Cosmetic truncation (5 names, 60 chars) of escaped untrusted names in CLI messages; no authority, evidence or decision effect.
